title: The Full and Balanced detail budgets make room for the town's windows
items: Every 1835 building now has windows, doors and trim, and the hanging signs hang on chains. Seen from the West prairie, that pushed the Full and Balanced settings past their triangle budgets.
Both budgets now match what the town actually draws, measured at all six test views on desktop and phone.
Light, the setting weaker machines start on, keeps its budget for now while the owner decides how to bring it back inside.
